text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After studying abroad at Central Tracen 
Academy, Furioso continued to achieve 
great feats from her third year onward...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The hero of Funabashi, the hero of the 
local circuits. Among all Umamusume 
hailing from Funabashi, none had ever 
achieved such racing results—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A re-proposal! What do you say, Furioso? 
Isn't it about time you considered 
transferring?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I understand your hometown 
pride. However, you must have realized it 
by now as well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Central Tracen Academy is a place of 
freedom. Even if you transfer, you can 
stay true to your feelings for your 
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To support her further success, we would 
be grateful if she could transfer to us, 
however...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Chairwoman... I truly 
appreciate the offer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
When you invited me before... I was still 
just a child.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I refuse!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I rejected your goodwill... purely out of 
hostility and emotion...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I reflect upon myself, realizing I knew 
nothing at all about what the 'JRA', the 
leader of the Umamusume world, truly 
meant.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ohh, then...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"However, this time as well... I must 
politely decline that offer."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even if it clouds my future, I want to 
keep my registration in Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Is your dedication driven by 
love for your hometown after all?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That is true as well. However, I... we 
are...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to leave it behind for posterity, 
no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The "historical fact" that an Umamusume 
representing Funabashi managed to reach 
the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"It might just be stubbornness. However, 
only historical fact can convey our 
resolve..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: We—intend to give our all to Funabashi.
choice_data_list:
Excuse me... Thank you very much, 
Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm, good. I have firmly received your 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Resonance! I, too, shall believe. That 
your determination will brightly 
illuminate Funabashi's future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All for the sake of Funabashi. The 
feelings Furioso had devoted for so 
long—finally bore fruit.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who witnessed Furioso's 
success up close went on to win graded 
stakes, and even GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Funabashi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Furioso-san! I'll 
take your teachings to heart and do my 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please stay true to your own race. If 
you do, you'll surely...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume mentored by Furioso 
immediately began achieving great results 
in Funabashi and across the NAR.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The light of Funabashi will never go out. 
It will continue to burn forever. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso's name was finally etched in a 
visible, lasting form.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The 1st Annual Furioso Legend Cup is 
finally about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Furioso, the great Umamusume representing 
Funabashi. The newly established race 
honoring her achievements is...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It takes place right before Furioso's very 
eyes! Funabashi Racecourse is bustling 
with excitement!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I can't believe something like 
this happened.
choice_data_list:
Ah, we managed to leave it—the guiding 
light.

Yeah, we managed to leave behind a guiding 
light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Aim to be like Furioso." "Aim for the 
race named in her honor." The Funabashi 
Umamusume who followed in her footsteps—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running earnestly, bringing in fans, and 
protecting Funabashi's racing culture.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Our efforts were... rewarded... 
We were able to... bring forth the spring.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to remain a symbol moving forward. 
As the steadfast "Grand General of 
Funabashi."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
And—let us watch over them, from right 
here, forevermore.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi's rising stars who bravely 
continue to challenge Central.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And once more, the gates open. Believing 
that even from the regional circuits, 
dreams can surely come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many Umamusume who achieved 
greatness while staying regional. Those 
who stayed true to their hometown pride 
without ever transferring. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even now, the one spoken of as the 
foremost among them is the 
Commander-in-Chief of Funabashi, Furioso."
